Require native filled-board DRC, bypass surface verification, plane connectivity and 0.5mm additional courtyard gap; no switch/load current through local bypass branch.
Capture and hash the exact primary ADI PDF; owning part currently records the binary source hash as unresolved.
Verify timing corners, startup/trigger sequencing, fault behavior and supply/switching interference in the assembled consumer; this macro does not qualify a hardware cutoff.
